Welcome to Simbaa Veterinary Clinic – Your Partner in Pet & Farm Animal Care! 🐾

Based in Nakuru, Simbaa Vet Clinic is committed to providing top-quality, affordable veterinary services for your beloved pets and livestock. Whether it's routine check-ups, vaccinations, deworming, grooming, or emergency care, we've got you covered with love and expertise.

🐶 Pet Care
🐄 Livestock Health
💉 Vaccinations
🧼 Grooming
📞 Expert Consultations

Subscribe for helpful tips, real-life animal stories, farm visits, and behind-the-scenes care moments!

📧 simbaveterinaryclinic@gmail.com

#HealthyAnimalsHappyHomes
